name: Review bank asset-quality evidence with LiquiLens MCP Client

parameters.content:
## 01 · Start here
Read one bank’s public asset-quality evidence.

**Run:** select **Execute workflow** once.

No LiquiLens account, API key or AI model is needed. Use your own n8n instance.

This workflow runs manually and sends no messages or orders.

[Setup guide](https://liquilens.in/developers/recipes/n8n-bank-review.md)

## 02 · Choose a bank
Example: **Cosmos Co-operative Bank** (`cosmos-ucb`).

To change banks, open **Fetch bank evidence** and edit `slug` in its JSON input.

Use `banking_specialisation_coverage` at the same endpoint to find valid slugs.

Keep authentication **None** and transport **HTTP Streamable**.

## 03 · Read the evidence
Open **Keep complete evidence** to inspect the research record.

Read the figures with their **dates, sources, missing values and interpretation limits**.

**Observed · Stale · Historical · Unavailable** describe evidence status. They do not establish deposit safety, predict failure or authorize credit.

MCP Client 1.1 stops on tool errors.
